English-Wizard.question: ১) What is the meaning of the idiom "At the outset"?
English-Wizard.option1: In the middle
English-Wizard.option2: The beginning
English-Wizard.option3: Towards the end
English-Wizard.option4: At outside
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ At the outset
English Meaning: the beginning.
Bangla Meaning: শুরুতেই / প্রারম্ভেই

Ex. Sentence: I told him at / from the outset I wasn't interested.
Bangla Meaning: আমি তাকে শুরুতেই বলেছিলাম যে আমি আগ্রহী নই।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ২) What does the English expression "Below the belt" mean?
English-Wizard.option1: Follow the rules
English-Wizard.option2: Direct and honest
English-Wizard.option3: Disregarding the rules
English-Wizard.option4: Beneath the belt
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Below the belt
English Meaning: disregarding the rules / unfair
Bangla Meaning: অন্যায়ভাবে

Ex. Sentence: Do you think it's a bit below the belt what they're doing?
Bangla Meaning: তোমার কি মনে হয় যে তারা যা করছে তা অন্যায়।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ৩) In case of working hard, you will prosper in life. (Complex)
English-Wizard.option1: Working hard, you will prosper in life.
English-Wizard.option2: If you work hard, you will prosper in life.
English-Wizard.option3: You work hard so that you will prosper in life.
English-Wizard.option4: You work hard that you will prosper in life.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Simple to complex:

• By/ In case of যুক্ত simple sentence টি যদি Modal auxiliary যোগে গঠিত হয়, তবে তা complex sentence এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম -
-  in case of এর পরিবর্তে  if বসে
- Subject বসে 
- Verb বসে
- Adjective /Noun বসে
- Comma বসে
- অপর বাক্যটি বসে।
- আর মূল Clause টি Future/ Present হলে If যুক্ত Clause টি Present Tense হয়।

Simple: In case of working hard, you will prosper in life.
Complex: If you work hard, you will prosper in life.

English-Wizard.question: ৪) Without studying hard, you will not pass the exam. (Compound)
English-Wizard.option1: Study hard or you will not pass the exam.
English-Wizard.option2: Study hard or so you will not pass the exam.
English-Wizard.option3: Study hard and you will not pass the exam.
English-Wizard.option4: Study hard yet so you will not pass the exam.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Simple to compound: 

• Simple Sentence এ without থাকলে Compound করার সময়: 
- Without বাদ যাবে 
- প্রথম clause টির imperetive sentence হিসেবে বসবে অর্থাৎ 'Study hard'
- দুটি clause-এর মাঝে or/otherwise বসবে এবং
- শেষের clause-টি বসবে। 

Simple: Without studying hard, you will not pass the exam.
Compound: Study hard or you will not pass the exam.

English-Wizard.question: ৫) A child likes only sweets. (make it negative)
English-Wizard.option1: A child likes not more than sweets.
English-Wizard.option2: A child likes nothing sweets.
English-Wizard.option3: A child likes nothing but sweets.
English-Wizard.option4: A child likes none but sweets.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Affirmative to negative:

• যদি Affirmative এ only/alone কোন বস্তুকে নির্দেশ করে, তাহলে উক্ত only/alone উঠিয়ে দিয়ে সে জায়গায় Nothing but ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

Affir: A child likes only sweets.
Neg: A child likes nothing but sweets.

 • তবে বয়সের ক্ষেত্রে বা সংখ্যার ক্ষেত্রে only এর পরিবর্তে not more than বসে।
Affirmative: He is only four.
Negative: He is not more than four.

Affirmative: They have only two cars.
Negative: They have not more than two cars.

• আবার, কোন Affirmative sentence এর শুরুতে Only/Alone  থাকে তখন Negative করার সময় Only/Alone উঠে গিয়ে বাক্যের শুরুতে None but বসে।
যেমন:
Affirmative: Only he can do the work.
Negative: None but he can do the work.

Source: Advanced Learner's by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ৬) On my reaching the station, the train left. (make it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: I reached the station and at the very moment of the train left.
English-Wizard.option2: I reached the station and at the very moment the train left.
English-Wizard.option3: I reached the station and the train left.
English-Wizard.option4: I reached the station and that the train left.
English-Wizard.exp:
প্রশ্নটি মুলত করা হয়েছিল Simple to Compound এর উপর কিন্তু ভুলক্রমে Complex চাওয়া হয়েছে।
অপশনে সঠিক উত্তর না থাকায় প্রশ্নটি বাতিল করা হলো। 
========================

• On/ At the very moment of = সাথে সাথেই
- On যখন কোন verb + ing এর আগে বসে তখন এর দ্বারা 'সাথে সাথেই' বোঝায়।

• Simple এ On/ At the very moment of থাকলে একে compound করার সময় 

- On/ At the very moment of উঠে যাবে
- Subject বসবে
- verb এর ing form past tense এ পরিবর্তিত হবে
- প্রথম clause এর বাকি অংশ বসবে
- প্রথম clause ও দ্বিতীয় clause এর মাঝে and at the very moment' বসবে
- তারপর দ্বিতীয় clause বসবে।

Simple: On my reaching the station, the train left.
Complex: I reached the station and at the very moment the train left. 
============================ 

যদি Simple to complex হতো তবে নিয়মটি হতো নিম্নরূপ:
- On/ At the very moment of উঠে যাবে
- As soon as বসবে
- Subject বসবে
- verb এর ing form past tense এ পরিবর্তিত হবে
- প্রথম clause এর বাকি অংশ বসবে
- কমা বসবে
- তারপর দ্বিতীয় clause বসবে।Simple: On my reaching the station, the train left.
Complex: As soon as I reached the station, the train left.

English-Wizard.question: ৭) Karim is always on time. (Negative)
English-Wizard.option1: Karim is never late.
English-Wizard.option2: Karim does not come late.
English-Wizard.option3: Karim is never on time.
English-Wizard.option4: Karim does not fail to come on time.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Affirmative to Negative:

• Affirmative sentence এ always থাকলে negative sentence এ পরিণত করার ক্ষেত্রে - 
- always এর স্থানে never বসে 
- affirmative word টির বিপরীত শব্দ বসে। 

Affir: Karim is always on time.
Neg: Karim is never late.

English-Wizard.question: ৮) She works hard in order to succeed in life. (Compound)
English-Wizard.option1: She worked hard so that she could succeed in life.
English-Wizard.option2: She worked hard and succeeded in life.
English-Wizard.option3: She works hard and be successful in life.
English-Wizard.option4: She wants to succeed in life and so she works hard.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Simple to compound এর সময়,

• to/in order to দ্বারা গঠিত বাক্যকে Simple to compound করার নিয়ম : 

• এ ধরনের বাক্যে Compound Sentence এ ৩টি কাজ করতে হয়। যথা -

1. Clause গুলোর অবস্থান উল্টে যাবে।
2. Want to অতিরিক্ত যোগ করতে হবে।
3. to/in order to এর পরিবর্তে ‘And so/ therefore’ conjunction যোগ হবে।

Simple: She works hard in order to succeed in life.
Compound: She wants to succeed in life and so she works hard.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ৯) What does the English expression "Bury the hatchet" mean?
English-Wizard.option1: Continue the quarrel
English-Wizard.option2: End the friendship
English-Wizard.option3: End a quarrel
English-Wizard.option4: Break an axe
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Bury the hatchet
English Meaning: end a quarrel or conflict and become friendly.
Bangla Meaning: ঝগড়া মিটিয়ে ফেলা

Ex. Sentence: Can't you two just bury the hatchet?
Bangla Meaning: তোমরা দুজন কি নিজেদের মধ্যকার ঝামেলা মিটিয়ে ফেলতে পারো না?

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ১০) What is the meaning of the idiom "Catch on"?
English-Wizard.option1: Become popular
English-Wizard.option2: Fall behind
English-Wizard.option3: Hold on tight
English-Wizard.option4: Lose interest
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Catch on
English Meaning: become popular.
Bangla Meaning: জনপ্রিয় হওয়া

Ex. Sentence: I wonder if the game will ever catch on with young people?
Bangla Meaning: আমার মনে সংশয় জাগে যে এই খেলাটা কি কখনো তরুণদের কাছে জনপ্রিয়তা পাবে?

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ১১) Despite being sick, Arian went to the office. (complex)
English-Wizard.option1: Arian was sick that he went to the office.
English-Wizard.option2: As though Arian was sick that he went to the office.
English-Wizard.option3: Though Arian was sick that he went to the office.
English-Wizard.option4: Though Arian was sick, he went to the office.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Simple to complex:

• Simple sentence এ যদি In spite of/ despite থাকে তাহলে complex sentence এ though/although বসে।

- Though/Although 
- subject 
- person ও number অনুসারে verb 
- 2nd clause (অপরিবর্তিত থাকে)।

Simple: Despite being sick, Arian went to the office.
Complex: Though Arian was sick, he went to the office.

English-Wizard.question: ১২) Besides eating rice, he took tea. (Compound)
English-Wizard.option1: He ate both rice and tea.
English-Wizard.option2: Not only he eat rice but also took tea.
English-Wizard.option3: He not only ate rice but also took tea.
English-Wizard.option4: He ate rice and also took tea.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Simple to compound: 

• Simple sentence এ “besides” থাকলে compound sentence এ “not only..….but also” structure ব্যবহার করে compound sentence টি গঠন করতে হয়।

Simple: Besides eating rice, he took tea.
Compound: He not only ate rice but also took tea.

English-Wizard.question: ১৩) You cannot but obey your parents. (Make it affirmative)
English-Wizard.option1: You cannot but obey your parents.
English-Wizard.option2: You must obey your parents.
English-Wizard.option3: You always have to obey your parents.
English-Wizard.option4: You have to obey your parents.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Negative to affirmative:

• Transformation এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Negative এ cannot but থাকলে Affirmative এ এর পরিবর্তে must বসে।

Negative: You cannot but obey your parents.
Affirmative: You must obey your parents.

English-Wizard.question: ১৪) He wanted to succeed and so he worked hard. (Make it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: He worked hard so that he could succeed.
English-Wizard.option2: When he wanted to succeed, he started working hard.
English-Wizard.option3: He worked hard for being succeed.
English-Wizard.option4: If he worked hard, he could succeed.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Compound to complex:

• Compound থেকে complex এ রূপান্তর করতে হলে প্রথমে দুটি clause এর মধ্যে সম্পর্ক কী সেটা আগে নির্ণয় করতে হবে।
- যেমন: কারণ-ফলাফল, কাজ-উদ্দেশ্য, ঘটনা-ঘটনার সময়, শর্ত-ফলাফল, ব্যক্তি-যে, বস্তু-যা ইত্যাদি।
 
• Compound থেকে Complex করতে হলে: 
- Compound এর Conjunction বাদ দিতে হবে; 
- Complex এর Conjunction যোগ করতে হবে; 
- 2টি Clause এর মধ্যে ১টি Clause যেভাবে আছে সেভাবে রেখে দিতে হবে।

• He wanted to succeed and so he worked hard.
- এই sentence এর clause গুলোর মধ্যে ‘কাজ-উদ্দেশ্য’ সম্পর্ক বিদ্যমান।
- তাই complex sentence এর conjunction হিসেবে so that বসাতে হবে।

Compound: He wanted to succeed and so he worked hard.
Complex: He worked hard so that he could succeed.

English-Wizard.question: ১৫) There are many students in the class. (make it negative)
English-Wizard.option1: There are not a little students in the class.
English-Wizard.option2: There are not many students in the class.
English-Wizard.option3: There are some students in the class.
English-Wizard.option4: There are not a few students in the class.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Affirmative to negative:

• Many যুক্ত কোন affirmative কে negative করতে হলে many এর পরিবর্তে not a few বসে। 

Affirmative: There are many students in the class.
Negative: There are not a few students in the class.

English-Wizard.question: ১৬) It is found nowhere but in Africa. (make it affirmative)
English-Wizard.option1: It is alone found in Africa.
English-Wizard.option2: None but only it is found in Africa.
English-Wizard.option3: It is found everywhere but in Africa.
English-Wizard.option4: It is found only in Africa.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Transformation এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Negative এ Nowhere but থাকলে Affirmative এ only বসবে।
- এবং এটা স্থানকে Modify করবে। 

Negative: It is found nowhere but in Africa.
Affirmative: It is found only in Africa.

English-Wizard.question: ১৭) He is too sleepy to stay awake. (Compound)
English-Wizard.option1: He is very sleepy and could not stay awake.
English-Wizard.option2: He is sleepy and cannot stay awake.
English-Wizard.option3: He is so sleepy that cannot stay awake.
English-Wizard.option4: He is very sleepy and cannot stay awake.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Simple to compound:

- Too + to যুক্ত Simple sentence কে Compound sentence এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
-Too এর পরিবর্তে very বসবে
- to এর পরিবর্তে and বসবে
- tense অনুযায়ী cannot/could not বসে
- to এর পরের অংশ। 

Simple: He is too sleepy to stay awake.
Compound: He is very sleepy and cannot stay awake.

English-Wizard.question: ১৮) I saw him at the time of playing. (Complex)
English-Wizard.option1: I saw him when he was playing.
English-Wizard.option2: I saw him when he is playing.
English-Wizard.option3: I saw him when he played.
English-Wizard.option4: I saw him when he plays.
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Simple to complex

যদি Simple sentence-এ at the time of থাকে, উক্ত simple sentence-কে complex-এ রূপান্তরের সময় at the time of-এর পরিবর্তে when বসে।

যেমন-
Simple: I saw him at the time of playing.
Complex: I saw him when he was playing.

English-Wizard.question: ১৯) What does the English expression "Head over ears" mean?
English-Wizard.option1: Superficially
English-Wizard.option2: Partially
English-Wizard.option3: Deeply
English-Wizard.option4: With hesitation
English-Wizard.exp:

Bangla Meaning: গভীরভাবে

Bangla Meaning: সে খুব ঋণগ্রস্ত।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ২০) What does the English expression "cut no ice" mean?
English-Wizard.option1: Slice through a frozen substance
English-Wizard.option2: Have no influence or effect
English-Wizard.option3: Make a clean break
English-Wizard.option4: Carve a sculpture
English-Wizard.exp:
♦ Cut no ice
English Meaning: have no influence or effect.
Bangla Meaning: নিষ্ফল হওয়া / ব্যর্থ হওয়া

Ex. Sentence: The salesman’s arguments cut no ice at all.
Bangla Meaning: সেলসম্যানের যুক্তি প্রমাণও ব্যর্থ হলো।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.
